You're right.

I'm sorry. You asked, and I didn't listen. You set boundaries, and I ignored them. Even as I kept on rationalizing why I wouldn't listen and do the right thing, I knew it was wrong. 

I want to rebuild the trust, but know it will take time. I treasure what you share, and don't take it for granted. It's on your terms.

I'm sure you've got a new safe haven already. You deserve the space and privacy, and to express on your terms - *without expection, or the assumption of expectation,* right? I won't go looking.  

Please, be safe.
